answer: A bond of 52% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in willow, and pearl reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an farming party cannot recycle one pool of capital across 196 aliases, and each one needs its own funded fable account. The attacker spends 250 dollars and 16 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
